verdict: Service in the window is significantly worse than the baseline on lateness_sec, late_share.

evidence: [F] 99% of late trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 18 Av: 209, at Church Av: 6, at Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 4, at Ditmas Av: 4. Largest time loss on segment 15 St-Prospect Park -> 7 Av (median +60s vs schedule).
[F] 85% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 7 Av.

[G] 96% of late trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Church Av: 83, at Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 20, at 15 St-Prospect Park: 11, at 7 Av: 8. Largest time loss on segment Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy (median +66s vs schedule).
[G] 79% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 7 Av.
Weekend problem rate is 1.6x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
56% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 3.1x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 34% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.5x the system share) in the analysed months.
[G] 65% of late trains were already late leaving Church Av: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[G] 63% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy, median +66s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
33% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 95%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
13% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 42% with an alert vs 21% without, lift 2.0x).
12% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'signal' alert was active for the line (problem rate 42% with an alert vs 21% without, lift 2.0x).
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 333s on average vs 104s otherwise (3.2x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 35% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 16% of delays on line(s) F, G (0.7x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Coney Island-Stillwell Av during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Inspect Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on F, G during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for F, G; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for F, G; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.
